# dsh-skill-manager
A standalone Skills page for DeepSeek Harness: every skill in one list with an enable checkbox. A sk
ill you uncheck leaves the model's catalog and is refused by the `skill` tool, so a long skill colle
ction stops costing context and stops getting invoked by accident.
## What it does

- **List** — every skill the harness can see, with a Chinese description for each.
- **Enable / disa
ble** — three scopes: 全局 (global), 本项目 (this project's working directory), 本会话 (this session). Narro

wer scopes only add restrictions.
- **Categories** — group skills into named categories you create;

purely visual, never changes what the model sees.
- **Search** — filters by name, description and Ch

inese description.
- **Separate page** — registers a `main` panel with its own sidebar entry, so it
is not a cell inside the conversation.
Disabled skills are filtered out of `ctx.skills.snapshot()` and blocked by a `ctx.tools.guard()` on
re filtered out of `ctx.skills.snapshot()` and blocked by a `ctx.tools.guard()` on the `skill` tool.

## HTTP bridge
The panel talks to its host half over `/api/dsh-skill-manager/{list,toggle,groups}`, served by the h
its host half over `/api/dsh-skill-manager/{list,toggle,groups}`, served by the harness web server.
## Development
Host JS is imported once per process: after editing `index.js`, disable and re-enable the plugin ent
ry to reload it. Client JS reloads with a page refresh.
`node smoke.mjs` runs a headless test of the client component tree (mini React runtime, fake fetch).
